title: pix_opencv_motempl
description: `pix_opencv_motempl` performs OpenCV-based motion detection, reporting each motion component as center X/Y, width, height, and angle; component `-1` represents the whole image. Its motion tracking can be tuned with parameters including threshold, component size limits, frame-buffer count, time deltas, aperture, and maximum track duration, and the patch notes that it works better with small connected components.
